args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, here's every Marrow Agrisupply site I could find in #central-team:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026 (ts 1781019960.000039). Ticket PD-4821 has the receiving-door import attached. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs fixing before anyone reimports so it doesn't create duplicates.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026 (ts 1781020080.000040). The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.
3. *Wichita store (probable)*: you, 2 Jul 2025 (ts 1751466060.000007). You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher, held in the Marrow Agrisupply office-hours Zoom room (Tobias's message just before, ts 1751466000.000006). The thread doesn't actually say Wichita is a Marrow store, so please confirm before you use it.

Two sites in that channel are *not* Marrow, so don't mix them up:
• Tulsa hub is Tansley Parcel (Lev Arkadin's yard jockey login issue).
• Door 6 gatehouse (#88412) is Tansleigh Packaging.

The 9 Jun thread also says three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just read "waiting," but the channel never names those stores. If they aren't Eastbank and Pine Crossing, the names aren't in #central-team. I only looked in #central-team, as you asked.
